description: Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations providing financial grants for hospitalization, prescription medicines, diagnostic laboratory tests, and burial assistance.
steps: Submit complete documentary requirements at the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) Help Desk.
Undergo social case evaluation and assessment with a registered social worker.
Receive Guarantee Letter (GL) for partner hospitals or proceed to City Treasury for cash grant disbursement.
requirements: Medical Certificate / Clinical Abstract from attending doctor
Hospital Bill or Official Prescription with price quotation
Barangay Certificate of Indigency from Roxas City barangay of residence
Valid Government-issued ID of claimant and patient

sources.name: DSWD Memorandum Circular No. 02 Series of 2014
CSWDO Roxas City Guidelines on Crisis Intervention

service: Cash Subsidy & Welfare Support for Solo Parents
description: Monthly financial aid, educational subsidy, and livelihood assistance provided to certified solo parents in Roxas City under RA 11861.
steps: Register and apply for Solo Parent ID at the CSWDO Roxas City.
Submit documentary proof of custody and single parenthood status.
Receive validated Solo Parent ID and inclusion in the city social benefit registry.
Receive designated periodic cash assistance payouts.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate of dependent children
Barangay Certification of Solo Parent status and residency in Roxas City
Affidavit of Solo Parent declaring custody of children without support
Income Tax Return (ITR) or Certificate of Indigency

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Registered Solo Parents residing in Roxas City
quickInfo.documents: Valid Solo Parent ID, Proof of Custody

sources.name: Republic Act No. 11861 (Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act)
CSWDO Roxas City Solo Parents Division

service: Senior Citizens Milestone Welfare & Centenarian Program
description: Provision of local cash incentives and national milestone honors for senior citizens celebrating milestone ages (80, 85, 90, 95, and 100) facilitated by OSCA Roxas City.
steps: Verify that the senior citizen is registered with the Office for the Senior Citizens' Affairs (OSCA) Roxas City.
Secure claim template and orientation at the OSCA Office, City Hall Compound.
Submit valid IDs and proof of milestone age for cross-verification.
Proceed to the City Treasury Office for cash gift release or receive home delivery for bedridden seniors.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate or Valid Senior Citizen ID issued by OSCA Roxas City
Barangay Certification of Residency confirming continuous residence in Roxas City
For representatives of bedridden seniors: Authorization Letter and Proof of Life photo

faqs.question: Where is OSCA Roxas City located?
faqs.answer: The Office for Senior Citizens' Affairs is located at the City Hall Compound, Washington St., Roxas City.

faqs.question: Are home visits conducted for bedridden seniors?
faqs.answer: Yes, OSCA and CSWDO staff conduct personal home visits for bedridden centenarians and milestone seniors to deliver benefits directly.

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Senior citizens aged 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100 residing in Roxas City
quickInfo.documents: Senior Citizen ID, Proof of Age

sources.name: Office for the Senior Citizens' Affairs (OSCA) Roxas City
